notes: This contract records a compile-only portable C++ TCK check for the IEEE 1516.1-2025 logical-time header directory requirement. The scenario includes the standard LogicalTime, LogicalTimeInterval, LogicalTimeFactory, integer64/float64 time, interval, and factory headers using their RTI/time paths and verifies declaration availability. It does not test runtime behavior, LogicalTimeFactoryFactory placement, exhaustive Annex C coverage, conformance, or interoperability.

api_surfaces.signature: Logical time declarations in RTI/time headers
api_surfaces.source_symbol: LogicalTime, LogicalTimeInterval, LogicalTimeFactory, and standard integer64/float64 declarations
